global_maxconn.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections for the global process.

defaults_timeout_connect.description: Maximum time to wait for a connection attempt to a server (in seconds).

defaults_timeout_client.description: Maximum inactivity time on the client side (in seconds).

defaults_timeout_server.description: Maximum inactivity time on the server side (in seconds).

defaults_retries.description: Number of retries to perform when a connection to a server fails.

frontends.description: List of frontend listeners for incoming Postfix policy queries.

name.description: Name of the frontend (alphanumeric, underscores only).

bind_host.description: IP address or hostname to bind to (e.g., 127.0.0.1 for localhost-only).

bind_port.description: Port to listen on for Postfix policy requests (commonly 12340 or 2465).

default_backend.description: Name of the backend to use by default (must match a backend.name).

backends.description: List of backend server pools for handling Postfix policy requests.

name.description: Name of the backend (must match frontend.default_backend values).

balance.description: Load balancing algorithm (e.g., roundrobin, leastconn, first).

check_enabled.description: Whether to enable TCP checks (recommended for reliability).

servers.description: List of Postfix policy servers (typically `postfix-policyd` instances).

name.description: Internal name for the server (used in logs and health status).

host.description: IP address or hostname of the Postfix policy server.

port.description: Port where the Postfix policy service listens (commonly 12340).

fall.description: Number of consecutive failed checks before marking server as down.

rise.description: Number of consecutive successful checks before marking server as up.

backup.description: Whether this server is a backup (only used when all primaries are down).

stats_enabled.description: Enable the built-in HAProxy stats web interface (for monitoring).

stats_port.description: Port for the stats web interface (if enabled).

stats_uri.description: Path for the stats web page (e.g., /stats).

stats_user.description: Username for stats web interface authentication.

stats_password.description: Password for stats web interface authentication (avoid defaults in production).
